args.body:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I understand you're experiencing API timeouts that are blocking your users, and I recognize the urgency of this issue.

We have opened a high-priority ticket (T-ext-E_CH_2_001) to track this matter, and our team is actively investigating the root cause.

Could you please provide any additional details that might help us resolve this faster:
- When did the timeouts start occurring?
- Which API endpoints are affected?
- Are you seeing any specific error messages?

We'll keep you updated on our progress.

Best regards

Responded to Priya's urgent API timeout complaint email. Requested additional details on when the timeouts started, which endpoints are affected, and any specific error messages. Awaiting further information from the client.
